title: ACME Cloud — Security and Compliance Overview
text: ACME Cloud encrypts customer data at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher. The platform is certified for SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001. Customer data is logically isolated per tenant; Enterprise customers may additionally request a dedicated database instance. Access to production systems requires hardware-backed multi-factor authentication and is logged. Data residency options are available for the EU and US regions; data does not leave the selected region except for aggregated, de-identified telemetry. Sub-processors are listed on the trust page and customers are notified 30 days before a new sub-processor is added. ACME does not train shared machine-learning models on customer content.
